schema:
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT NOT NULL, tier TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE employees (emp_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, dept_id INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments (dept_id));
correct_query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.status = 'active') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.emp_id) FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN departments AS T2 ON T1.dept_id = T2.dept_id WHERE T2.region = 'west' GROUP BY T2.tier ORDER BY T2.tier DESC, CAST(SUM(T1.status = 'active') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.emp_id) NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant groups by primary key T1.dept_id instead of non-key attribute T2.tier while ordering by tier DESC and conditional percentage ASC with LIMIT 1
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.status = 'active', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.status) AS pct_active FROM departments AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.dept_id = T2.dept_id WHERE T1.region = 'west' GROUP BY T1.dept_id ORDER BY T1.tier DESC, pct_active NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
